subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or recreate the open fork PR for this cron stagger bug, or close that candidate and allow a fresh same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains in current main and the latest release, but an open fork PR already closes this issue, so automation should not start a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or recreate the fork fix
options.body: Review the fork PR approach and recreate it on a maintainer-owned branch if fork workflow or proof requirements block direct landing.

options.title: Land the fork PR directly
options.body: Use the existing contributor branch if maintainers are comfortable with the fork workflow and can bring checks and proof up to the repository bar.

options.title: Close the fork candidate first
options.body: Close the linked fork PR if maintainers reject its approach or want a fresh same-repo implementation to own the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Adopt or recreate the fork fix
recommendation.body: Review the fork PR approach and recreate it on a maintainer-owned branch if fork workflow or proof requirements block direct landing.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the affected cron stagger helper and its service/docs integration, making them the best history-backed routing candidate for the maintainer choice.
